name: Media Views Filter
description: A Views string filter that searches media by media name, file name, file URI and thumbnail alt/title in one field, plus two Views display fields (file URL link, alt text).
project_description:
The Media Views Filter module provides a Views text filter that allows filtering/searching by both media name and file name, as well as other media attributes.

The distinction between files and media is a "Drupalism" that is needlessly confusing for those new to Drupal. A file entity and a media entity each have their own name, but the media content views provided by Drupal core (for example at /admin/content/media) only allow filtering by media name, not file name. Meanwhile, the core files content view (at /admin/content/files) allows filtering by file name, but provides no way to edit the associated media entity(ies). What if a content editor is trying to find a file, but only remembers the file name, not the media name? If you install this module, your content editors will thank you.

Features: provides a Views text filter that allows filtering/searching by media name, file name, and media image alt text field/attribute; provides a Views field to display file name/path; provides a Views field to display media image alt text.

Post-Installation: edit a core media view (for example at /admin/structure/views/view/media), add a new filter criteria "Media name/file name", expose it to visitors, remove the original "Media: Name" filter, save. Optionally add the "File name" and "Alt text" fields to the view output for transparency.
notes: Ships one hook_views_data() implementation that registers three handlers on the core media_field_data table. (1) Filter media_file_name_filter -> filter id 'media_file_name' (class Drupal\media_views_filter\Plugin\views\filter\MediaFileNameFilter, @ViewsFilter). It extends the core Views StringFilter but restricts operators() to ONLY 'contains' (unsets =, !=, word, allwords, starts/ends, shorter/longerthan, regex, empty/not empty). Its query() adds a standard (LEFT) relationship from media_field_data.mid to file_usage.id, an INNER relationship from file_usage.fid to file_managed.fid, then GROUP BY media_field_data.mid (and media_field_data.changed) to de-duplicate rows. It removes the default WHERE it would have gotten on media_field_data.name, opens a new OR where-group, and searches the single entered value against five columns with LIKE '%value%': media_field_data.name, file_managed.filename, a REPLACE(REPLACE(file_managed.uri,'public://',''),'private://','') expression, media_field_data.thumbnail__alt and media_field_data.thumbnail__title. (2) Field media_file_name -> field id 'media_file_name' (class MediaFileName, @ViewsField): query() is a no-op; render() loads the source File via $media->getSource()->getSourceFieldValue($media), then File::load(), and returns Markup::create() of an <a> tag linking to $file->createFileUrl(). (3) Field media_alt_text -> field id 'media_alt_text' (class MediaAltText, @ViewsField): query() no-op; render() returns $media->get('thumbnail')->getValue()[0]['alt']. No config, no schema, no permissions, no services beyond injected 'database' and 'plugin.manager.views.join'. info.yml declares NO explicit dependencies key, but the code hard-requires media, views and file to function; package 'OHSU' (Oregon Health & Science University). LIKE search values are escaped with connection->escapeLike() and bound as parameters (no SQL injection). The filter is designed to be EXPOSED and typically placed on the core media_library / admin/content/media views.
